description: For incident, this log form records immediate care, scene control, notification chain, evidence preservation, preliminary classification, and reporting duties. Its supporting evidence includes firsthand statements, scene photos, equipment status, training record, timeline, and corrective-action evidence.

use_case: Use the log form during construction incident stabilization and fact record when the incident record must identify people involved, exact location, activity, equipment, witnesses, environmental conditions, and emergency response. Complete the applicable handoff for qualified review, required notifications, corrective actions, return-to-work authority, and record retention.
